children: Indonesia's rice output in the January-to-October period is seen reaching 31.41 million metric tons, little changed from the 31.44 million tons produced in the same period in 2025, statistics bureau data showed on Tuesday.

The government has taken measures to prevent rice production being affected by drier-than-usual weather due to the El Nino pattern, such as bringing forward the planting period and distributing water pumps.
